purpose.summary: Add a bounded physical-pruning oracle to the public legacy-compatibility matrix without changing node or consensus code.
scope: Extend only mixed-node-coexistence with manual physical pruning on the exact baseline and candidate roles.
Build 150 near-megabyte blocks from baseline getblocktemplate data, require proposal acceptance by both roles, and submit the same raw blocks independently to both datadirs.
Require physical block and undo file deletion, preserved chain and UTXO state, clean same-datadir restart, and post-prune mining by both roles.
exclusions: No production-node, consensus, activation, native-asset, optional-indexing, testnet, or mainnet-parameter change.
No new scenario ID, build role, inherited functional-test selection, automatic-pruning claim, or evidence promotion.
No private source, history, operator material, host metadata, binary, or incoming evidence.

files.test_reachability: Documents the governed restart, reconstruction, and physical-pruning lifecycle contract.
Exercises honest two-node coexistence, clean restart, full reindex, chainstate reindex, and manual physical pruning.
Runs the identity-bound fail-closed public matrix and requires all reviewed lifecycle markers.
Covers runner contracts, reconstruction and physical-pruning canaries, record binding, and fail-closed paths.

commands: Configure and build the exact Bitcoin Static v24.0.5 public baseline with the reviewed dependency profile.
expected_results: The baseline daemon is bound to the exact baseline commit, tree, build profile, and binary digest.

commands: Configure and build the exact direct-child public physical-pruning harness with the same reviewed dependency profile.
expected_results: The candidate daemon is bound to the reviewed commit, tree, build profile, and binary digest.

scenarios.command: Run the governed two-node legacy/candidate coexistence, restart, reconstruction, and physical-pruning scenario.
expected_results: Alternating mining and clean same-datadir restart preserve exact chain, UTXO commitment, and raw-tip projections.
Full reindex and chainstate-only reindex on both roles emit fresh lifecycle markers, restore the exact pre-rebuild snapshot, and accept one new block mined by each role.

Only after both reindex lifecycles, both roles restart their unchanged datadir directories in manual-pruning mode, accept identical baseline-template-bound large blocks, physically remove the first block and undo file pair, agree on a bounded readable prune height, preserve the exact tip and UTXO state across same-datadir restart, and accept post-prune mining by each role.
failure_conditions: Any process, proposal, raw-block acceptance, lifecycle-marker, physical-file, prune-mode, chain, UTXO, raw-tip, post-prune restart or mining, cleanup, or identity divergence fails closed.

scenarios.command: Run the corrected zero-subsidy mining fixture with the baseline daemon.
expected_results: The inherited mining fixture passes without skip under the exact baseline role.
failure_conditions: Any skip, timeout, nonzero exit, identity mismatch, or cleanup failure fails closed.

scenarios.command: Run the corrected zero-subsidy mining fixture with the candidate daemon.
expected_results: The inherited mining fixture passes without skip under the exact candidate role.
failure_conditions: Any skip, timeout, nonzero exit, identity mismatch, or cleanup failure fails closed.

scenarios.command: Run the unchanged inherited feature_abortnode.py selection through its default node-launch path.
expected_results: The inherited default-launch scenario passes with byte-equivalent selection.
failure_conditions: Any inherited-selection drift, skip, timeout, nonzero exit, or cleanup failure fails closed.

platforms: Ubuntu 22.04 arm64 with the reviewed public dependency profile
macOS arm64 local contradiction testing only

limitations: The public report observes only the exact ERGON-CHANGE-0007 candidate and cannot promote any later code or operator binary.

The four passing scenarios establish a bounded synthetic short-chain regtest observation with cross-node synchronization, clean restart, full reindex, chainstate reindex, and manual physical pruning on both roles.

The pruning oracle observes removal of the first block and undo file pair, a bounded readable prune height, preserved chain and UTXO state across same-datadir restart, and post-prune mining by both roles.

The normalized report does not serialize raw logs, physical paths, or per-role pruning measurements; those oracles are enforced by the exact signed scenario and are not independently recomputable from the report alone.

Automatic target pruning, corrupt storage, permissions and disk exhaustion, interrupted pruning or reconstruction, crash recovery, reindex or redownload after pruning, and reorganization across pruned history remain untested.
Historical-chain replay, sustained operation, public-network peers, and mainnet remain untested.
Binary digests and config.ini source/build bindings do not prove build causality, and the dependency profile is not locked.
Operator-binary equivalence and mainnet coexistence remain unproved.
This evidence has an assembled-component ceiling and is not an independent reproduction pack.
counterevidence: No contradiction was observed inside the four declared public oracles, including the bounded manual-pruning lifecycle.
Manual pruning does not establish automatic-pruning, pruned-history recovery, deep-reorganization, public-network, or mainnet behavior.
Build causality, operator-binary parity, historical-chain and real-datadir parity, sustained operation, and mainnet coexistence remain evidence gaps.
